node.statement: Let h=K_hom and q=h/2. The map x↦gamma(x^dagger)^dagger is complex linear because both involutions are conjugate linear, so tilde_gamma is complex linear. Entrywise amplification gives tilde_gamma_n(X)=(gamma_n(X)+gamma_n(X^dagger)^dagger)/2. Hence tilde_gamma_n(X^dagger)=(gamma_n(X^dagger)+gamma_n(X)^dagger)/2=tilde_gamma_n(X)^dagger exactly. Moreover, using the isometry of the matrix involution and node 1.2, ||(tilde_gamma_n-gamma_n)(X)||=(1/2)||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=q e||X||, uniformly in n.
